description: This Java class 'ModuleFilterMapping' models the mapping of a web filter to servlets and URL patterns within a module in the OpenMRS platform. It provides methods to manage, evaluate, and parse filter mappings from XML configuration files.

classes.name: ModuleFilterMapping
classes.description: A class representing the mapping of a Filter to associated Servlets and URL patterns, including logic to parse XML configurations and evaluate filter applicability.

methods.name: ModuleFilterMapping
methods.description: Constructor requiring a Module to instantiate the filter mapping.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this filter mapping.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module associated with this filter mapping.

methods.name: getServletNames
methods.description: Returns the list of servlet names mapped to this filter.

methods.name: setServletNames
methods.description: Sets the list of servlet names.

methods.name: addServletName
methods.description: Adds a servlet name to the list.

methods.name: getUrlPatterns
methods.description: Returns the list of URL patterns mapped.

methods.name: setUrlPatterns
methods.description: Sets the list of URL patterns.

methods.name: filterMappingPasses
methods.description: Determines if a request path matches the filter's URL patterns or servlet names.

methods.name: urlPatternMatches
methods.description: Checks if a request path matches a specific URL pattern.

methods.name: servletNameMatches
methods.description: Checks if a servlet name matches a pattern.

methods.name: retrieveFilterMappings
methods.description: Parses a module's XML config to retrieve filter mappings.
